description: Free, no signup. Request any feature, including payment methods we do not yet support. Examples include finding live parking by facility, comparing school district finances across states with local-cost-adjusted spending per student, downloading CSV results, or requesting PayPal or Bitcoin Lightning. For payment requests, name the method and the agent task it would enable. Dataset capabilities require dataset; endpoint/suggestion require description (10-800 characters), no dataset needed. Use public examples, never credentials or personal information. Retain the private receipt/status_url. A receipt confirms recording, not support, delivery or a review date.
name: request_capability
title: Request a feature, payment method, data or endpoint
